title: Orphan noir
blurb: Fifties crime from the independents that made it and moved on: Ida Lupino's hitch-hiker, John Alton's shadows, and a heist half of Hollywood borrowed from.

films.note: An armoured-car robbery by four masked men who never see each other's faces. The heist film a generation of heist films borrowed from.
John Alton's lighting: faces cut out of black. Cornel Wilde against a mob boss who is always one step ahead.
Ida Lupino directs: two friends on a fishing trip pick up the wrong man. In the National Film Registry.
A kidnapping, a prison break and Broderick Crawford at his most menacing.
Bogart, John Huston and a Truman Capote script, made up on the day. A flop that became a cult comedy.
Raymond Burr as a lawyer who defends a woman he loves, then finds out what she did.
